definitions.gloss: Buddhist sutra; Buddhist scripture; chanting of sutras
definitions.explanation: Sacred Buddhist texts that are chanted during religious ceremonies, funerals, and memorial services. The お prefix adds a respectful or familiar tone.

examples.japanese: お{坊|ぼう}さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧お{経|きょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: The monk is chanting a sutra.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法事|ほうじ}→法事：05634_houji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{経|きょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: We had a sutra chanted at the memorial service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{経|きょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}えている→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother chants sutras in front of the Buddhist altar every morning.

notes:
USAGE:
The お prefix is standard and almost always used in everyday speech. The plain form ⟦{経|きょう}→経：24866_kyou⟧ alone is more formal or literary. The most common verbs used with お{経|きょう} are ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read/chant), ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to offer up), and ⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧ (to recite).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{経|きょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to chant a sutra)
- お{経|きょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to offer sutra chanting)
- お{経|きょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧ (to recite a sutra)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Sutra chanting is central to Japanese Buddhist funerals and memorial services. Even families who are not actively religious typically have sutras chanted by a monk at funerals (⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧) and annual memorial services (⟦{法事|ほうじ}→法事：05634_houji⟧).
